summary: English and French first-party discovery identified Géo Sénégal, Senegal DGID's NICAD procedure, and ONDDL SIG. The bounded public ONDDL WFS inventory contained only administrative layers; no Louga cadastral parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained. No geometry sample is retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, actual result URLs, direct request outcomes, scope limits, safe field allowlist, and uncertainty are recorded in city-1557-louga.json. No login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS bypass, or unsafe-field request occurred.

custodians.name: Senegal DGID
custodians.scope: National fiscal/domain/cadastre authority documented by the official NICAD procedure; no Louga-local public parcel endpoint was evidenced.

custodians.name: Géo Sénégal / Sénégal Numérique SA
custodians.scope: National official geospatial-data portal with Louga land-use and urban/base datasets; no cadastral parcel layer qualified.

custodians.name: ONDDL SIG
custodians.scope: National territorial-data portal with a public GeoServer WFS inventory; only administrative layers were exposed in the bounded capability response.

full parcel polygon geometry only when safely returned
scopeLimits: The WUP point [15.6206112652558, -16.2252500871381] and population 193553 persons are preserved in the city record.
No parcel layer was exposed by the bounded ONDDL WFS capabilities response, and no parcel query was issued against an unqualified layer.
Géo Sénégal's Louga downloads are land-use/urban/environmental data, not qualified cadastral parcel geometry.
No unsafe land-record fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission.
uncertainty: A protected, interactive, or non-indexed Louga cadastral service may exist outside the public routes inspected.
DGID's local-office procedure confirms custodial process generally but not a Louga-specific public API or map.
No independent runtime adapter qualification was performed.
